text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"When I headed to the track with Inari One 
to train—"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, looks like someone's already here. 
That's Ticket, and... who's the other one?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking over, two students were deep in 
conversation with Winning Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*! I get how you guys feel. So... 
I'll let you guys have my track time...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I'm... just in the way, so... I'm 
going hoooooome~~~!
choice_data_list:
Looks like trouble! I need to hurry and 
stop them—

Looks like trouble! I need to hurry and 
stop them—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Wait, wait, waaaait!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, hold on!! What are 
you guys doing?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ganging up to steal my course, huh? You've 
got some nerve!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Inari-san? When you say "take by 
force"...

text_block_list.name: Blonde Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-zo-senpai! Inari-senpai is right! 
It wouldn't be right for us to take the 
track from you!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—So in other words, Ticket-zo overheard 
you guys talking about giving it your all 
for your debut race, and...
choice_data_list:
So you offered to give up your training 
spot because you were so moved, is that 
it?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I overheard it while I was 
getting ready for training...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"You're my rival, and I want to run a GⅠ 
alongside you. Let's both do our best in 
the upcoming selection race." ...She wrote 
that?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you say that with such sparkling 
eyes made me want to do something too... 
*sniff*, waah!

text_block_list.name: Black-Haired Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! I'm really touched by how you feel, 
Senpai! And I'm grateful to get as much 
practice in as possible before the real 
thing...! But—

text_block_list.name: Blonde Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Our dream isn't something we want to 
fulfill at the expense of someone else's! 
That's why...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Heh, you... are you really—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Now that's stylish!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What do ya say, Boss? How about letting 
them use my training slot too?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"How about it, Boss? How about letting her 
use my training slot too?"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The friendship of her juniors, and how 
they give their all for their dreams. 
Ticket-zo's kindness. When shown such 
pure, spirited determination—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I won't be able to settle down unless I 
lend a hand too!
choice_data_list:
Alright, shall we run the outer track 
today!

text_block_list.name: Blonde Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
E-Even Inari-senpai and the others?! Then 
what about the practice we planned on the 
track—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What're you blabberin' about? Nobody said 
this was for you lot!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'm doing this for my own sake, you know?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Repaying style with style— that's the 
true Edokko way!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"So there's not a damn thing to worry 
about! Just puff out your chest and run 
wild however you like!!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
How about joining in, Ticket-zo? Wanna 
keep me company on the outer lap?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! Of course! Thanks for pacing with 
meeee!!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you so, so much!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the two of them ran along the 
riverbed relentlessly until their stamina 
ran out—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah! Not bad at all! Feels even better 
than running on a real track!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Me too! It feels so 
refreshing, doesn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha! I guess running alongside someone 
with real style is the best!
choice_data_list: It's nice to do this once in a while.
It's nice to do this once in a while.
Makes me want to go for a run too...
You're making me want to run too...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha! I guess running alongside someone 
with real style is the best!
choice_data_list: It's nice to do this once in a while.
It's nice to do this once in a while.
Makes me want to go for a run too...
You're making me want to run too...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Besides, with Ticketzo, how should I 
put it... we just click!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, me too! Um, um! Want to go for 
another run!?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: "I'm on! Alright, let's gooo!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, the two of them happily 
kept running through the setting sun.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oho, now you've said it! You heard that, 
right, Ticket-zo?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Alright, Trainer, we're starting on 
ready-set-go~~!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Let's run together with all our might and 
wrap this up in style!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I worked up a good sweat 
chasing after the two of them running 
along the riverbank in the evening sun.
